## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Studio N?
D2, 4th Floor, Adarsh, No. 8, Sarangapani Street, T. Nagar, Chennai 600 017.

### What facilities does Studio N have?
Turnkey interiors, Bespoke homes, Contemporary villas, Pool villas, Landscapes, Apartment interiors, Corporate interiors, Healthcare interiors, Construction.

### Who founded Studio N?
Studio N was founded in 2018 by Nirmala S, a woman entrepreneur with many years in the field before that.

### Do you build as well as design?
Yes. Studio N works in residential and corporate interiors and construction, with turnkey execution.
